entry_state: The literature and architecture now lead to a defined feasible-history set. Every candidate must satisfy joint constraints and contextual observation intervals within the declared model; an empty or singleton result is not a verdict on reality. The next sections examine certain answers and what balance conservation omits.
findings: 85–86: The two100-payable histories distinguish answer families,certain rows and Boolean certainty. Empty row intersection does not remove a certain liability; union would invent200. Libkin theorem conditions and sound-but-incomplete evaluation are explicitly separated from the local construction.

86–87: The kernel argument requires both movements to satisfy remaining constraints; the receivables bridge retains classified unknown movements. Balanced atomic batches preserve a balanced opening vector by induction,while account treatment and report classification need additional evidence.

88: Policy,event generation,accounting measurement and atomic transition have defined inputs and date information. Inner expectations cannot use realized future paths; pricing measures remain distinct from business-outcome measures.

88–89: Unweighted conditional-law families precede the measurable-kernel mixture. The5/7 example gives7−2w; variance decomposition follows from a conditional mean-zero cross term. Weight-class extrema require admissible measures; equivalent histories are relative to requested outputs,horizon and scenarios.

90: Principal F,V replaces the bilinear fraction-times-debt expression under stated domain conditions. Future interest4.975 is attained and7.035 is only a supremum. Quantisation and unsupported/timeout/unbounded statuses stay distinct. Family construction begins with explicit finite templates and shared unknowns.

Rendered85–90 read in order. Twenty-five unchanged completed units explicitly reaffirmed after reading; no new defect confirmed. This is mathematical exposition review,not a new solver run or literature audit.
